steps.en: Set up providers, then start the daemon (dashboard on :4200)
steps.zh: 配置 provider，启动守护进程（仪表盘在 :4200）

steps.en: Activate a bundled Hand — or author your own HAND.toml
steps.zh: 激活一个内置 Hand——或自己写 HAND.toml

steps.en: Runs the Hand on its schedule, LLM calls and tools inside the WASM sandbox
steps.zh: 按日程驱动这个 Hand，LLM 调用与工具都在 WASM 沙箱里执行

steps.en: Reports over your connected chat channel and logs every action to the audit chain
steps.zh: 通过你连接的聊天渠道汇报，每个动作记入审计链

value.en: Agents that do work on a timer, unattended — one process instead of cron + queue + webhooks + dashboard glue
value.zh: 智能体按定时器无人值守地干活——一个进程，不必再拼 cron、队列、webhook 和仪表盘
